import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    keep = []
    used = set()
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    n = len(ids)
    
    for i in range(n):
        if i in used:
            continue
        keep.append(i)
        used.add(i)
        
        # Find correlated features to exclude
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            if j in used:
                continue
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                used.add(j)
    
    kept_ids = [ids[i] for i in keep]
    kept_x = feats.x[:, keep]
    
    # Compute t-statistics for all kept features
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(kept_ids):
        x1 = kept_x[feats.y == 1, i]
        x0 = kept_x[feats.y == 0, i]
        if len(x1) > 1 and len(x0) > 1:
            t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x1, x0, equal_var=False)
        else:
            t_stat = 0
        t_stats.append(abs(t_stat))
    
    # Sort by t-statistic magnitude
    sorted_indices = np.argsort(t_stats)[::-1]
    top_features = [kept_ids[i] for i in sorted_indices[:min(MAX_DRIVERS, len(kept_ids))]]
    
    # Check for interaction terms among top features
    products = []
    for i in range(len(top_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(top_features)):
            a, b = top_features[i], top_features[j]
            products.append((a, b))
    
    # Create drivers and columns
    drivers = tuple(top_features)
    columns = tuple(kept_ids)
    products = tuple(products[:len(products)//2]) if len(products) > 0 else ()
    
    # Weighted score: use t-statistics as loadings
    loadings = dict(zip(kept_ids, t_stats))
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=columns,
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
